author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: v0.9 (2026-11-14): optional Notification device. Turn on Notification device on the TV's Preferences page and Save to create a '<TV name> Notifier' child that shows Hubitat notifications (Rule Machine, Notifier, Basic Rules, HSM) on the TV screen as an on-screen toast. Adds the LG TV (Glasshouse) Notifier driver. v0.8 (2026-11-11): initial public release. Requires Hubitat 2.2.0+.
